use.read_order: Match a static question to a topic; use its four-phase guidance and optional detailed step numbers. Read only its cited spans when needed.
use.invalidate: Validate with python tools/check_handoff.py on a changed checkout. Any bound source hash mismatch makes this cache stale; review changed facts before rebinding.
use.current_state: No current statuses, prompts, counts, return identities, credentials or credit balances are cached. Use the existing selected process guide/runner when those facts are required.
use.not_authorization: Navigation data only; does not execute another engine, select scope, answer SME questions or clear gates.

steps.title: Use the four-phase path; expand details only when needed
Choose the person responsible for each action
Recognize the three fictional process packages
Optional: extract the historical fictional sample
Use the repository as workspace by default
Understand editable inputs and frozen process evidence
Open the one Process.md template
Provide job roots and prose; source supplies the steps
Collect one nonsecret setup bundle before opening connectors
Open PowerShell and prepare the locked Python environment
Prepare the fixed empty input folders
Prepare the one private workspace .env
Place the two approved CA files
Prepare clean Zowe configuration and its secure login
Prepare local Db2 stdio and launch Claude
Open the Workbench and click New process
Select Process.md and mark a practice run as fictional
Put the complete export in Endeavor
Map this process and follow its four stages
Let the same flow discover missing exports
Copy the current retrieval prompt
Launch Claude and send the exact retrieval prompt
Continue after Claude saves evidence
Open the source breakdown and inspect one rule
Select Yes or No deliberately, then Save
Select CICS fields and actions in a separate process
Copy the analysis prompt using approved safe evidence
Preserve legacy behavior and inspect v5 test obligations
Handle missing evidence without switching hosts
Accept only the fresh local analysis return
Download the issued SME review file
Have the SME answer and save the single-file return
Import the authentic return through the UI
Wait for verification and open the report
Compare source and Python one program at a time
Filter gaps and record the exact remediation need
Check every exported file and line is accounted
Open the registered database view
Inspect records and exact identifiers
Compare protected run effects and historical baselines locally
Download the executive deck and evidence bundle
Track measured effort and actual provider credits
Preview an estate estimate without pretending it is measured
Close and resume the same workspace
Use the checkpoint table when you cannot proceed
Review this draft and provide your criteria

topics.answer: Use four phases: Prepare once; Provide Process.md and Endeavor; Choose rules/build; Compare. Claude handles approved read-only retrieval and safe development/tests/review; Coordinator owns evidence/gates. Humans own rule Save and the single authentic SME return. Originals/credentials/rows stay protected.

Repository is default workspace: Process.md, Endeavor/, certificates/ and empty supplemental/JCL, JCLPlus, PROCConverted, Copybooks, ControlCards. Exact Zowe NOT_FOUND allows a named supplemental export then Continue; Db2/dynamic/ambiguous objects are excluded. Each stable ID owns input/analysis/review/synthetic/tests/target/reports; shared targets use shared/target. No per-rule Markdown/source-path questions. Preserve WEBELX/Tran and frozen identities.

Fill one Process.md: stable ID/name, numbered actual jobs in run order and freeform knowledge. Download template, select Your Process.md, Map this process. No separate notes/source choices. Validated JCL/PROC supplies registered hash-bound job plans; declared roots stay unchanged. Unknown/dynamic bindings stay gaps. CICS uses actual transaction/program bindings. Legacy tables/XLSX are optional.

Run foreground Setup.ps1, workspace_inputs and knowledge preflight in the repository; then Start.ps1. Setup falls back from py -3.12 to PATH CPython 3.12, reuses valid .venv and restores PIP_USER after locked install. Never run parallel pip/launch retries. NoBrowser only suppresses browser. Explicit alternate workspace stays consistent. LF hashes stay stable; CI is not Windows 11 desktop acceptance.

Ask one bundle of missing nonsecret facts: selected dev/prod HTTPS pairs, TSO account/code page/logon procedure, Db2 DDF/host/port, approved CA files and registered driver. Repository is default workspace; Endeavor is fixed. Selected pair is complete, unused pair blank, Unknown explicit. Credentials/private .env/rows stay local. Offline practice skips remote facts.

Copy .env.example to workspace .env only if absent; preserve existing bytes. Canonical 8 Db2 + 11 Zowe keys: database=DDF, SSL=true, selected endpoint complete, TSO supplied. Enter credentials only in local editor/secure prompts; stdio cannot prompt. Quote literal spaces/#/$, no expansion. .env differs from .venv/.env.txt; never print/upload/commit contents.

The fixed certificates/ folder holds real approved DB2-CA.cert (PEM/DER) and ZOWE-CA.pem (PEM). .env relative paths resolve from its workspace directory. Placeholder/config validation is not trust/access. Never weaken TLS. A company-blocked Endevor/Zowe connection remains a named gap; use the authorized complete local Endeavor export. TPX is not an API host.

Exit all VS Code windows. Fresh PowerShell sets full workspace NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS before Node, cd workspace, zowe config secure (local credentials), then code --new-window. .env alone does not sign in Explorer. Keep TLS/secure store; only bounded CLI privately loads .env. No secret JSON/arguments/model output.

After native text setup, run Start.ps1 and click New process. Download/fill Process.md if needed, select Your Process.md and Map this process. No Save setup or source choice is required first; local Endeavor is automatic. Optional Setup keeps compatibility settings. Stage buttons and Back inspect recorded evidence; Return to current stage restores the eligible action. Config is not access.

Locked Python tools/setup_zowe.py --workspace . --from-env --env-file .env prepares clean project config/schema from supplied templates, without requiring old profiles. Secure project_base and complete DevPlex/ProdPlex HTTPS pairs use selected defaults; TSO metadata creates no session. Approved PEM CA/TLS are mandatory. Conflicting config stays a preservation gate. Explorer needs separate secure-store login; the bounded CLI may load local credentials. No jobs/writes; I* and Z* are different identities.

Locked Python db2_setup --workspace . --env-file .env, then Start-Claude.ps1 -Workspace . Use actual IBM driver, database=DDF, TLS/approved DB2-CA.cert. Credentials stay local; stdio cannot prompt. Claude owns managed typed MCP child: no HTTP port/token/second server. Offline activates none. Trust/auth/read gates remain; no arbitrary SQL or model-visible rows.

Endeavor first; configured lazy Zowe maps known exact missing refs. Remaining/Db2 needs use current Claude prompt with typed MCP. Local closure never initializes connections. Copy current prompt unchanged; exact request/need IDs and inbox bind returns. Opaque identities need sanctioned safe views, never hash guessing/private reads. Continue validates saved receipts. Ask only exact remaining facts after approved retrieval fails. Never query fictional names live.

Default Yes is conversion scope, not approval. Choose or clear source-bound rule checkboxes and explicitly Save requirements and continue. Save pins Markdown; selected No keeps its reason and earns no parity credit. Unsaved choices are not evidence; a hash/revision conflict requires reloading saved choices. Dependencies remain gates. Packet issue freezes scope; revisiting a stage does not reset it.

After actual scope Save, use the current Claude prompt and approved sanitized semantic evidence for implementation/tests/adversarial review. SOURCE/PROGRAM/RULE hashes are exact task aliases resolved privately; never reverse them by reading originals. Missing safe semantics stays a gap. After tested adapters, restart the idle loaded service if needed, refresh and submit a fresh task-bound analysis file. Acceptance is not verification, and a plan clears no gap.

New fixture-v5 processes require 64 distinct randomized valid source states per applicable logic/layout/step; 128 only for recorded compound-predicate, cross-layout compared-key or prior-effect risk. Actual target comparisons and positive/negative/boundary/malformed/linked-state/mutation witnesses are separate obligations. Repeated or finite/unreachable states remain deficits. Expectations freeze first and historical floors stay frozen. Finite tests do not establish native parity.

Preserve evidenced legacy behavior, including apparent source defects. Refactor/consolidate only with verified observable equivalence and source/target/test mappings. Report preserved source issues; never silently repair/retire them. Unverified native Db2/mainframe operations remain exact named gaps. Old dates, available libraries or selected No do not grant parity credit.

For online CICS, supply actual transaction/controller bindings and full program/BMS/COPY/resource evidence, with approved sanitized views for model reasoning. Human Save chooses source-bound screen fields/actions. BMS layout may verify separately; SEND/RECEIVE, AID, session/security/recovery and data effects need real equivalents. Layout-only targets disable controllers. HTTP success is not CICS parity; unsupported action semantics stay gaps.

Share the one issued self-contained sme-checklist.html. The actual SME answers Yes/No/Not sure, comments, enters their name and Save review file downloads the answer-bearing return. Import once with matching attribution. Agents never fill answers or infer consent; any correction/comment stays unresolved even with Yes. New HTML v2 supports 128 MiB; frozen HTML v1/XLSX stay 8 MiB. Stop the UI before direct runner import; packet/shell/identity/quota checks remain.

Review & compare → Program comparison → Program → Gaps only. View source, replacement and evidence shows legacy logic, target/database spans, satisfaction, saved scope, tests and precise gaps. No says excluded by requirements. Missing equivalents stay gaps; shared target spans prove no equivalence. Detailed source is protected operator-local content.

Every retained export/file/physical line gets a disposition and evidence/reason, including unknown files and selected No. Retained, selected, original, verified and omitted totals differ. Unique versions and cross-job memberships differ; repeated calls do not inflate them. Empty/unknown denominators are not 100%. Accounting completeness is not behavioral equivalence. Protected originals/reports stay local.

Authorized operator-only localhost Db2/SQLite view uses registered hash-checked read-only artifacts. Application database/Table and exact filters preserve leading zeros, integers and NULL. Never send real rows/screenshots to a model. Schema preparation requires saved Yes scope, closure and accepted Db2 provenance; empty schema is not business SQL or data migration. Arbitrary SQL and unsafe artifacts are refused.

db2_export_snapshot_to_inbox(process_id,request_id,need_id) writes protected rows to exact local inbox; model sees path/hash/count/scope only. Snapshot-only safe receipts can continue without reading private response.json; mixed unresolved receipts remain gated. Deterministic local comparison binds keys/input/run/environment/completeness/consistency and separates baseline/final/run effects. Equal five-row deltas cannot hide twenty historical source-only rows. Uncommitted read lacks qualified native parity; never run legacy jobs.

Use the registered accepted report and management.pptx; six editable slides share frozen evidence for components, size/rules and gaps. Python AST statements are not equivalent COBOL rules. Eligible immutable bundles retain report evidence; stop UI before a direct runner bundle. Executive labels clear no gates. Sensitive source/row bundles are not model context.

Import actual provider/account usage receipts in Effort & scale or --measurement-file. Credits used stays attributed; historical Copilot does not become Claude usage. Known zero differs from Unknown. Do not derive credits, allowances or savings from tokens, requests, currency or configuration. Missing receipts/billing remains Unknown.

Record real stage effort, stopping clocks for human waits and separating framework work. Forecast only the same counting unit from explicitly labeled low/base/high assumptions or complete attributed eligible pilots. Unknown estate/capacity can stay unissued; forecasting is optional for conversion. Process is not JCL PROC. Fictional/blocked/partial/excluded pilots cannot calibrate full estate. Work/service/elapsed differ; a one-pilot projection is provisional.

Python/SQLite is registered/executable. Oracle, BigQuery, Java and .NET require implemented TargetBackend generation/comparison and the same execution, fidelity, scope, linked-state, adversarial and reporting gates. Configuration supplies no adapter. BigQuery needs workload/transaction qualification; it is not automatic transactional Db2 substitution.

Rerun Start.ps1 from the same repository workspace and select the saved process; Refresh checkpoint reads its eligible action. Preserve ledger, immutable input/hashes and one SME quota. Changed input needs an explicit new ID. Stop work clocks before closing; keep one Coordinator. Stage/back navigation is inspection, not reset. Never rewrite evidence or delete locks/command markers to clear a gate.

This cache has no live status/prompts/inbox identities/counts/billing. Read the selected UI guide; for status-only CLI stop UI first. runner agent uses the running Coordinator inbox and can advance queued/historical work, so inspection is not universally read-only. Use safe projections; do not rescan raw databases/ledger or add a status proxy.

Errors sit under the failed input/action. Correct the named cause and retry; stale same-process details remain visible disabled during refresh. Reconnect to this workspace clears persistent connection loss. Refresh checkpoint reads current state. Missing safe semantics, scope Save, fresh analysis or human review stays gated. PENDING is not accepted and uncertain actions need inspection before retry. WAITING_COPILOT is a historical key, not a dependency.

Four primary phases and 46 optional steps retain original sampleZIP/text and 33 explicitly historical captures. Follow current text; new captures are scoped local synthetic UI observations. Never query sample names live or use them as SME/forecast evidence. Screenshots prove no Windows 11 desktop, enterprise access or parity.

prompts/CONTEXT.md routes to the compact authoritative owners; it is not live status or approval. This source-bound cache answers static how-to questions and relevant line spans, avoiding unrelated rescans. Current facts use safe UI projections. Validate changed checkout hashes before trusting the cache.

Use examples/process-specific.md as the one WORKSPACE/Process.md template, or download it in New process. Stable roots and freeform knowledge travel together; no separate notes upload is required. Intake freezes original bytes and process-context.json; source-derived job plan stays separate and hash-bound. Legacy external notes are optional. Cite safe known facts/Unknown; no per-rule/process CONTEXT.md or customer values.

Original source/customer records stay protected in the approved network: no model/MCP raw-row response, prompt/API/upload/screenshot/diagnostic exposure. Comments/literals/control cards can contain PII. Use sanctioned sanitized semantics and synthetic or explicitly approved masked examples; missing safe context is a gate. Operator-local rows differ from model access. Regex/config is not DLP certification.

Start-Claude preserves saved config and activates only managed Db2 with temporary strict-mcp-config; explicit separate workspace uses add-dir. Stdio needs no token. Trust/policy remain actual human prerequisites. Project denials protect originals/inboxes/rows/SME/scope/derived evidence/secrets and risky tools, not certify OS/DLP or approve safe views. Scoped reviewers lack human authority; never auto-approve all servers.

Record table grain, keys/relationships, NULLs, units, leading zeros, effective dates and quality/reliability in freeform Process.md with citations; intake indexes the context. Reusable validated utility facts use one application catalog. Distinguish observed/inferred/Unknown. Approved metadata/safe examples only; no per-table/rule Markdown or customer rows. Catalog/context facts are not semantic proof or approval.

Fifteen pinned instruction-only adaptations plus four mainframe skills use .claude/skill-pack.json. Validate check_skill_pack.py and reopen cached clients. Use relevant guidance after Start/contract; do not preload everything. No MCP/hooks/proxy/runtime is installed by these skills. Headroom is local and Karpathy independently authored. Skills cannot replace Coordinator gates/humans; validation does not prove host activation.

Process.md accepts 1 MiB UTF-8. Local Endeavor permits 10,000 files, 16 MiB/file, 512 MiB combined and 2 million physical lines; browser source upload 32 MiB. There is no 800 KB ceiling. New HTML v2 accepts 128 MiB; frozen HTML v1/XLSX stay 8 MiB. Preserve bytes; unsafe/binary/ambiguous inputs remain gaps. These finite bounds are not memory/stress or universal encoding certification. Stop UI before direct attributed runner import.
